# Getting Help

> — *"Hey, the extension crashed."*  
> — *"Run **Evaluate: Copy Diagnostic Report** from the Command Palette and paste it into an issue — no need to reproduce."*  
> — *"But I already reloaded the window..."*  
> — *"Doesn't matter — **Evaluate: Open Previous Session Logs**, grab the file from the crashed session."*

That's the whole workflow. Logs are always recording and persist across
crashes and reloads (last 5 sessions), so a bug you can't reproduce is
still a bug we can fix.

- **Bugs:** [open an issue](https://github.com/nunezbenj/vscode-evaluate-expression/issues) — the template walks you through attaching diagnostics. ⚠️ Reports include recently evaluated code and results; redact anything sensitive.
- **Questions:** GitHub issues, or the Q & A tab on the [marketplace page](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=nunezbenj.pycharm-evaluate).
- **Maintainer:** [Benjamin Núñez González](https://github.com/nunezbenj) (`nunezbenj`). Colleagues: come find me directly.
